name: app.remotehunt/remotehunt
title: RemoteHunt
description: Search open remote jobs by role and the country you live in; check if a job can hire you.

tools.name: search_remote_jobs
tools.description: Find open remote jobs on RemoteHunt for a job title or profession. With the country the person lives in, only jobs whose postings say they can hire there are returned. Returns up to 10 jobs with title, company, posting age, stated pay, where each job can hire, and a link to its RemoteHunt page.

role.description: Job title or profession, e.g. "product designer" or "data analyst".
role.title: Role

country.description: Country the person lives in: a name or an ISO code, e.g. "Brazil" or "BR".
country.title: Country

level.description: Optional level: junior, mid, senior or lead.
level.title: Level

limit.description: How many jobs to return, 1 to 10.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: can_job_hire_me
tools.description: Check whether one RemoteHunt job can hire a person who lives in a given country, from where the posting says it hires. Takes a RemoteHunt job link (remotehunt.app/job/...).

job.description: A RemoteHunt job link or its slug.
job.title: Job

country.description: Country the person lives in: a name or an ISO code.
country.title: Country

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Details of one RemoteHunt job: title, company, stated pay, where it can hire, level, must-have skills, a short excerpt of the posting and the link to apply. Takes a RemoteHunt job link (remotehunt.app/job/...).

job.description: A RemoteHunt job link or its slug.
job.title: Job
